caseNameFull: Moody v. Albemarle Paper Co. and Williams v. Albemarle City Board of Education

opinions.text: Parties granted leave and are invited to file briefs on or before February 13, 1974, in form specified by Rule 39 of the Rules of this Court, in response to question certified by the United States Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit. Reported below: See 474 F. 2d 134 and 485 F. 2d 232.
